title: Lakota cosmology of the Black Hills as a sky place
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lakota cosmology of the Black Hills as a sky place, about traditional at Black Hills, South Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In Lakota cosmology, the hills are specifically a sky place, a star map where ceremonial sights on the ground mirror the constellations above

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that among the Lakota, a Native American people, the Black Hills of South Dakota are seen as a sky place. In his words they are a star map, with ceremonial sites on the ground mirroring the constellations above, which he raises as a sign that the land is tied to the heavens.
